howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.headline: Make better use of what you own.
howItWorks.intro: Before buying new clothes, make better use of the pieces already in your wardrobe. RYVENCA suggests outfits only from your own pieces and explains each one with a Match Score and the reasons behind it.

photo.title: Take a photo
photo.text: On a hanger, on the bed or on the sofa — a regular phone photo is enough.

organize.title: Get organized
organize.text: We detect the color automatically; with category and season, your wardrobe organizes itself.

discover.title: Discover your outfits
discover.text: Outfits made only from your own pieces, with a Match Score and an explanation.

hero.title: What should I wear today?
hero.text: Let us suggest the best outfits from the real pieces in your wardrobe.
